source: HM Revenue and Customs, Payrolled employments in the UK by nationality, region and industrial sector, from July 2014 to December 2025, published 14 April 2026 (table: Monthly counts of payrolled employments in the UK, by nationality). Joined with DWP Stat-Xplore NINo registrations to adult overseas nationals, January 2025 to December 2025.
caveat: HMRC RTI counts employments, not employees: one person with two jobs is counted twice. The series excludes the self-employed, students not working, dependants and the inactive. 47 nationalities are published; smaller cohorts appear only in the UK, EU and non-EU totals. National granularity only: there is no local authority RTI by nationality. NINo flow and HMRC payroll are different concepts and should not be summed.
